title: GMCP evidence stays valid on distilled release branches
goal: Distilling the 2026-11-11 release candidate failed accept verification (T-TRUTHDOCS-1's gmcp_requirements) with 'tested_commit ... is not in HEAD's history' for every GMCP vector: local-distill re-applies commits onto the release base, so evidence recorded on main is never an ancestor there and no distilled release could pass. Accept a tested commit reachable from the Source-Commits of HEAD's Distilled-Task commits, keep the byte-identical digest checks, test it on a real Git fixture, and re-record GMCP evidence for the changed test file.

results.tests: cargo test -p susi --test gmcp_requirements: 88 passed, 0 failed on main b7a36b4c7 (87 before + tested_commit_history_follows_distillation_provenance)
results.evidence: 54 requirement checks re-recorded at 2f7bbc7d9 and 9 mastery checks at 8f8e2a20d with cargo local-release record-gmcp

limitations: Linux x86_64 4-thread cloud container only; Windows not run.
